fact: On 27 April 2023 the DGI launched e-Hetraphone in Anosy and Androy, open only to taxpayers holding a NIF, and the ANJARA Hetrako campaign issues the tax card immediately against a CIN and residence certificate.
title: Campagne ANJARA Hetrako - L'année 2023 démarre à ANOSY et ANDROY
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
